title: pm-dispatch(decision-analysis): write or re-read a decision card's four-axis analysis at the ceiling tier when available
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7umuhQHbtifzCQo7sEiZzA)_

Fixes #27265

## What changes

One line of guidance at the end of `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/decision-analysis.md` 〈落卡分析模板〉:

> - 四维与推荐:天花板档可用即用它写成或复读后落卡;否则按席位档落,加 `Analysis-tier:` 行。

A seat filing a decision card writes or re-reads the four-axis analysis and the recommendation at the ceiling tier (`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`) when it is available. When it is not, the seat files at its own tier and adds an `Analysis-tier:` body line. ⛔ No gate, no recogniser, no half-state row: the line is per-card guidance, not a surface mandate (standing ruling 「同意,维持面强制,不全上 fable」).

## Why

The maintainer's words on the card, verbatim and in order:

1. 「立决策卡时,如果有fable,是否建议先用 fable 审核之后再立?」
2. On the seat's recommendation (four-axis analysis only, use when available, not a new gate, one line, an `Analysis-tier:` line otherwise): 「同意」

## Line budget (paid in the same file, as #27846 did)

- Ceiling row `['.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/decision-analysis.md', 49]` in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` is unmoved: 49 → 49.
- +1: the new line, 119 bytes (cap 120).
- −1: the two opening bullets of 〈四棱卡面块固定形状〉 folded into one 110-byte line. Only restated words were deleted, with no re-wrap:
  - 「⛔ 不留待维护者到场再补」 restates 「落卡即带」.
  - 「用中文写」 restates SKILL.md's invariant (四维 is one of the four Chinese channels; 四维中文只管新记录).
  - 「机器可寻」 is restated by the next line's 「提取按字面 grep」.
  - 「任一即满足」 restates 「等价」.
- Home is not SKILL.md: SKILL.md is at its ceiling and the template a filing seat copies from is this file.
- The wording names the ceiling tier (天花板档), not a model id. SKILL.md's claim template spells the ceiling `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` and refuses copied model ids.

## The claim-line checker (reported, not changed)

`post-stamped.mjs`'s claim-line owner (`containerModelRefusal`, imported from `dispatch-gates.mjs`) accepts a ceiling `model:` line that carries `reason: …` naming the per-card ruling. The value is free text, so it needs no stable anchor. A claim cites this rule as `reason: decision-analysis.md 〈落卡分析模板〉, maintainer ruling on #27265`. No checker change is owed.

## Verification

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 17 families on `194b3ea06`. All 17 ran and exited 0. `--ran` reports 「17 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED」. `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 (prerequisite: unbuilt `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint`); it exited 0 after the printed `turbo run build`. The list was re-derived after the commit and is identical. `check:pm-skill-ratchet` and `check:pm-skill-id-lint` are green. No changeset is derived as owed (nothing published), so this PR carries `skip-changeset`.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:决策卡分析模板加一行,四维分析与推荐在 fable 可用时用它写成或复读后再落卡,不可用则正文注 `Analysis-tier:`。
- 为什么改:落实您 10-28 对 #27265 的「同意」;决策卡是您亲自裁的文本,值得最高档来写。
- 风险与回滚:只是一行指引,不加门禁也不加检查;同文件合并两行旧文字付行,行数仍 49;回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`decision-analysis.md` 新增的第 32 行,以及第 36 行合并后的那一行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet && pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` 两项绿。
- 需要你做的:暂无;本 PR 欠一次 fable 契约复审,落地档位以登记册在 PR 时的读数为准。
